request.curl:
curl -s -X POST "$BASE/api/auth/dev-login" \
  -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt \
  -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email":"admin@dev.local","name":"Dev Admin"}'

steps.title: Ask for a plain-language storage summary (admin)

body.summary: The system holds 14 files: 13 in fast (hot) storage and 1 archived (cold). Together they are 7.1 MB as users see them but occupy 6.9 MB on disk, saving 219 KB (3%). Of 63 downloads, 6 (10%) had to wait for an archived file to be restored, and a download starts in about 81 ms on average.
suggestions: The storage optimizer has not run since the server started. Run it from this page to archive files that are no longer used.
body.note: No AI API key is configured on the server, so this summary was written without AI from the same numbers.
